notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year & Patch Notes 1.12
notes.notes:
Adventurers, the Chinese Year of the Snake is approaching, and we wish you all a happy New Year!

We’ve been continuously optimizing the game and creating new content, and we truly appreciate your ongoing support and love for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284683/675a2ee5129b8dfdf4a69aa495c68e23fa2642dc.png[/img]

[h3]Update 1.1.2 includes:
[/h3]
1.New street scenes added: Barber Shop and Bookstore.
2.Chapter 2 – THE GREAT UNDERGROUND ADVENTURE: A new mini-game has been added.
3.Chapter 3 – RESTING PLACE: A new scene has been added.
4.New characters have been introduced.
5.Added 2 new SNIPPETS.
6.Added 1 new COLLECT item.
7.More characters will appear on the Afterword street.
8.Optimized English translations.
9.Fixed several bugs.
Thank you again for your continued support! We’ll keep bringing you more surprises and updates.

notes.title: Game Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
1.Optimized the issue of excessive game caching；
2.Streamlined some chapter title screens during gameplay for a smoother experience.  These chapters remain available and can still be accessed via Chapter Select；
3.Optimized success detection in the boiler room pipe puzzle；
4.Fixed an issue where Willy could get separated during chase sequences；
5.Fixed overlapping text in the dialogue log；
6.Fixed an error with unlocking the Mr.HornBell achievement；
7.Fixed typos in the game；
8.Optimized some invisible walls；
9.Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Announcement regarding Mercury Abbey release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Thanks for all of your support for Mercury Abbey.

In the past 1 year, we have devoted ourselves to game development: polishing the plot, enriching the game content, upgrading the game screen and so on.
At the same time, more interesting characters have been created by our team. 
More than [b]40 furry characters[/b] will appear in the game, and [b]each character has its own detailed background story[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284683/6c488c52a590545dc50b696f3d09899df6d0bc45.png[/img]

All these efforts are aimed at bringing players an amazing, interesting and colorful furry world.

However, the workload of these contents go beyond all our expectations. 
In addition, Chengdu has suffered from[b] COVID-19, high temperature, power limited in summer and other troubles[/b] this year, which also delayed the development of Mercury Abbey.

We have been working overtime to catch up and planned to complete the development within this year, but many interesting elements and details will be deleted then.
Therefore, we decided to[b] postpone the release of the game for better game experience and higher game quality[/b].

As for the date, we will tell all players as soon as we confirm it. I believe our game is worth waiting for.
We are looking forward to that day, we will embark on the adventure with you.

At last, thanks again for all the players' support!
